Pharmacopoeias. In Eur. (see p.vii). Also in USNF. Ph. Eur. 6.2 (Caraway Oil). The oil obtained by steam distilla- tion from the dry fruits of Carum carvi. A clear, colourless or yel- low liquid. Relative density 0.904 to 0.920. Store in well-filled, airtight containers at a temperature not exceeding 25°. Protect from light. USNF 26 (Caraway Oil). The volatile oil distilled from caraway. It contains not more than 50% v/v of carvone (C10H14O). Soluble 1 in 8 of alcohol (80%). Store in airtight containers. Protect from light. Profile Caraway oil is an aromatic carminative and is used in gastroin- testinal disorders and as a flavour. It is also employed as caraway water for infant colic (see Gastrointestinal Spasm, p.1696). Preparations BP 2008: Aromatic Cardamom Tincture; Compound Cardamom Tinc- ture.
